Image generation with an empty prompt returns 400

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "liter_llm"
begin
  api_key = ENV.fetch("API_KEY")
  client = LiterLlm.create_client(api_key)
  result = client.image_generate_async(LiterLlm::CreateImageRequest.new(model: 'dall-e-3', n: 1, prompt: '', size: '1024x1024'))
rescue StandardError => error
  warn "#{error.class}: #{error.message}"
```
